commands.label: Execute native VBScript in the Windows console host

program.vbs.content_utf8:
Option Explicit
Dim Response
Set Response = New AspResponse
Response.ContentType = "text/plain"
Response.Charset = "utf-8"
Response.Write "Hello, " & "World!"

WScript.StdOut.Write Response.ContentType & "|" & Response.Charset & vbLf
WScript.StdOut.Write Response.Body
Class AspResponse
    Public ContentType, Charset, Body
    Private Sub Class_Initialize()
        Body = ""
    End Sub
    Public Sub Write(Value)
        Body = Body & CStr(Value)
    End Sub
End Class

toolchain: Microsoft Windows Script Host VBScript via cscript.exe
reproduction_command: cscript.exe //B //Nologo program.vbs; request /hello.asp from the local Response fixture
semantic_scope: The original embedded VBScript ran in the Microsoft script host using a standalone Classic ASP Response fixture. A private HTTP request returned status 200, the original content type and charset, and the exact greeting.
